t: This is the Kennington Park Shelter Victims Memorial, a war memorial here in the park. It was made by Richard Kindersley, a British typeface designer, stone letter carver and sculptor. That background matters, because with a memorial like this the lettering carries much of the meaning. Look closely at the carved words and how they sit on the stone. I don't have more detail on the history here, so take a quiet moment to read what's inscribed and reflect on the people it remembers.
